name: Blanc wa Kataranai
source:
This month's theme at the photography club is "daily life".
The protagonist was thinking really hard about what photo she would take,
but that wasn't the only thing occupying her at the time.

There were also the blank letters she kept getting every day.

They came in envelopes with a single cherry blossom flower on them,
but the sender wouldn't reveal their name.

The inside was completely blank as well.

"It's just a prank, it has to be."

She tried to convince herself of that, but...

She never noticed what these letters are really trying to tell her.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/8840]Freem![/url]]
translation:
摄影部这个月的主题是“日常”。
正当主人公苦思冥想该拍什么照片时，
困扰她的还不止这一件事。

还有那些每天都会寄到她手上的无字信。

信封上印着一朵樱花，
寄信人却没有留下姓名。

里面的信纸同样一片空白。

“这肯定只是恶作剧而已。”

她努力这么说服自己，然而……

她始终没有察觉到，这些信件真正想要向她传达的讯息。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/8840]Freem![/url]]
